report_encoding.format: JSON indented with two spaces followed by exactly one trailing newline
report_encoding.empty_collections: Every collection is present as an empty JSON array when no findings exist. Never emit null for a collection.
report_encoding.paths: Slash separated and relative to the analysis root. The root itself is the empty string.

ordering.edges: from then to then scope then constraint then source
ordering.cycles: lexicographic comparison of the full canonical cycle lists
ordering.nested_string_arrays: constraints, required_by, sources, and declared_by are each deduplicated and sorted lexicographically

source_values.hosted_custom: hosted followed by one space and the URL, for example: hosted https://pub.internal
source_values.git: git followed by one space and the URL, for example: git https://git.example/shared.git
source_values.path: path followed by one space and the cleaned relative path, for example: path ../beta
source_values.sdk: sdk followed by one space and the SDK name, for example: sdk flutter

constraint_values.default: any when no constraint is declared or the dependency uses a path, git, or sdk source
constraint_values.normalization: surrounding quotes removed and interior whitespace collapsed to single spaces, for example: >=1.0.0 <2.0.0

cycles.encoding: Each cycle is a closed walk over local package names. The walk starts at the lexicographically smallest package in the cycle and the starting package name is repeated again as the final element.
cycles.deduplication: Rotations of the same cycle are reported once, in canonical form only.
cycles.membership: Only path or name references that resolve to packages discovered in this workspace participate in cycles.

missing_lockfile.when: A package declares at least one dependency and has no pubspec.lock file. Reported once per package.

missing_dependency.when: A declared dependency has no entry in the lockfile packages section.

version_mismatch.when: The locked version does not satisfy the declared constraint. Not checked when the constraint is any.

source_mismatch.when: The bare source kind in the lockfile differs from the bare kind declared in the manifest. Compare only the first word of the source, never the URL or path portion.
source_mismatch.expected: the declared bare kind, one of hosted, git, path, sdk

conflicts.when: The intersection of every declared constraint for a dependency is empty, or the dependency resolves to a local workspace package whose version fails that intersection.
conflicts.fields: constraints holds the deduplicated sorted constraint strings and required_by holds the deduplicated sorted declaring package names

unused_dependencies.when: A regular dependency of a package is never imported by any Dart file under that package lib or bin directories using a package import.
unused_dependencies.exclusions: Development dependencies are never reported as unused.

source_inconsistencies.when: The same dependency name is declared with two or more distinct canonical source strings across the workspace.
source_inconsistencies.fields: sources holds the distinct canonical source strings and declared_by holds the declaring package names, both deduplicated and sorted

malformed_input.definition: A pubspec manifest with a missing or empty name, a missing or empty version, an invalid semantic version, or a tab character. Two discovered packages sharing one name are also malformed.
malformed_input.behavior: The command exits with a nonzero status and prints a diagnostic to standard error.

yaml_subset.list_entries: Lines beginning with a dash outside the dependencies and dev_dependencies sections, such as Flutter asset lists, are ignored rather than treated as errors.
yaml_subset.comments: Full line and trailing comments outside quotes are ignored.
